sections.chapter_title: Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)
sections.text_helper: Section 71.6.16 "FDCAN TT capture time register (FDCAN_TTCPT)" in chapter 71 (Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3738.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x013C
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:16 SWV[15:0]: Stop watch value
On a rising / falling edge (as configured via FDCAN_TTOCN.SWP) at the stop watch trigger pin,
when FDCAN_TTOCN.SWS] is different from 00 and FDCAN_TTIR.SWE is 0, the actual time value
as selected by FDCAN_TTOCN.SWS (cycle, local, global) is copied to SWV and
TFDCAN_TIR.SWE is set to 1.Capturing of the next stop watch value is enabled by resetting
FDCAN_TTIR.SWE.
0x0000 to FFFF Captured stop watch value
Bits 15:6 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 5:0 CCV[5:0]: Cycle count value
Cycle count value captured together with SWV.
0x00 to 3F: captured cycle count value
